title: Drug tracking on hydra
author: Ida Barlow
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8z4hx8w
materials: Allow the plates to dry for 30 minutes
Use wormsorter to dispense 2 worms per well

Protocol parameters: # multichannel pipette parameters and tipracks multi_pipette_type = 'p10-Multi' multi_pipette_mount = 'left' tiprackdrugs_slots = ['3'] tiprackdrugs_type = 'opentrons-tiprack-10ul' tiprackdrugs_startfrom = '1' tiprackH2O_slot = '6' tiprackH2O_type = 'opentrons-tiprack-10ul' # tiprackH2O_startfrom = '1' # water trough H2O_source_slot = '9' H2O_source_type = 'trough-12row' H2O_source_well = 'A1' H2O_volume = 5 # drugs source drugs_source_slots = '2'#,'5','8','11'] drugs_source_type = '96-well-plate-pcr-thermofisher' frombottom_off = +0.3 # mm from bottom of src wells drugs_volume = 3 # destination plates agar_thickness = +3.7 # mm from the bottom of the well for 200ul agar per well destination_slots = ['1','4','7', '5'] destination_type = '96-well-plate-sqfb-whatman' n_columns = 12 # create mapping from sources to destination. seed = 20191031 # for reproducibility. Let's use the experimental date for the actual experiment, something else for debugging np.random.seed(seed)
Make sure all labware is loaded correctly

steps.title: Refeed worms onto plates
steps.instruction: Pipette four small droplets of bleach‑synchronised worms onto each of four 150 mm plates 2.5 days before tracking (e.g., 5 pm Monday for Thursday tracking).

steps.title: Prepare low‑peptone plates
steps.instruction: Retrieve low‑peptone 96‑well plates from the 4 °C fridge, weigh three plates, place the remaining plates in the flow hood to dry for 3 h; after drying, re‑weigh and confirm at least a 3 % mass loss before proceeding.

steps.title: Dispense low‑peptone NGM
steps.instruction: Using the VIAFILL dispenser, pour low‑peptone NGM into the 96‑well plates, dispensing 200 µL per well; after the plates have cooled, weigh three plates and store them lid‑side down at 4 °C.

steps.title: Create drug source plates
steps.instruction: In a skirted 96‑well plate, assign each column to a single drug at a single concentration; add per well 0.2 µL of 1000× drug in DMSO and 2.8 µL water to achieve a final DMSO concentration of 0.1 %; scale the master‑mix volume as volume_per_well × 8 × n (n = number of destination plates).

steps.title: Run Opentrons dispensing robot
steps.instruction: Load the prepared protocol onto the Opentrons robot; the robot will randomise column locations from each source plate to each destination plate using the current date as the random seed; ensure destination and source plate locations are specified.

steps.title: Label destination plates
steps.instruction: Label each destination plate with the identifier of the source plate used and its location in the Opentrons robot.

steps.title: Add diluted OP50
steps.instruction: With the VIAFILL dispenser, add 5 µL of 1:10 diluted OP50 to every well of each drug plate.

steps.title: Dry plates after OP50
steps.instruction: Allow the plates to dry for 30 minutes under the flow hood.

steps.title: Incubate plates overnight
steps.instruction: Cover the plates and keep them at room temperature overnight in the dark (some drugs are light‑sensitive).

steps.title: Wash worms from tracking plates
steps.instruction: Using a Pasteur pipette, wash worms off the 150 mm plates with M9 buffer into 15 mL Falcon tubes.

steps.title: Pellet worms by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin the Falcon tubes at 1500 rpm with an ascending ramp of 9 s and descending ramp of 7 s for 2 minutes to pellet the worms.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and resuspend
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, then add M9 buffer to the pellet.

steps.title: Repeat washing steps
steps.instruction: Repeat the centrifugation (step 11) and supernatant removal/resuspension (step 12) two additional times.

steps.title: Combine washes and adjust volume
steps.instruction: After the final wash, fill the Falcon tube with M9, transfer its contents to a 50 mL tube and bring the volume up to 45 mL with M9.

steps.title: Incubate worms in drug
steps.instruction: Incubate the worm suspension in the drug solution for 4 hours.

steps.title: Monitor robot tip removal
steps.instruction: Run the robot protocol and watch to ensure all pipette tips are removed.

steps.title: Replace tip racks
steps.instruction: After each destination plate is filled, replace the tip racks.

steps.title: Final plate drying
steps.instruction: Allow liquid on the plates to dry for 30 minutes under the flow hood.
